pages.text: PROBLEM 16-5 Which of the following alkyl halides would you expect to undergo Friedel–Crafts reaction with rearrangement and which without? Explain. (a) CH3CH2Cl  (b) CH3CH2CH(Cl)CH3  (c) CH3CH2CH2Cl  (d) (CH3)3CCH2Cl (e) Chlorocyclohexane
